description: Source code for a GPIO emulator driver in Zephyr RTOS, implementing GPIO pin configuration, input/output handling, interrupt simulation, and callback management.

methods.name: get_pins_with_flags
methods.description: Returns a mask of pins matching specified flags and mask.

methods.name: get_input_pins
methods.description: Returns a mask of pins configured as input.

methods.name: get_output_pins
methods.description: Returns a mask of pins configured as output.

methods.name: gpio_emul_config_has_caps
methods.description: Checks if the port has specified interrupt capabilities.

methods.name: gpio_emul_gen_interrupt_bits
methods.description: Generates interrupt bits based on pin state changes and trigger type.

methods.name: gpio_emul_pend_interrupt
methods.description: Handles pending interrupt events after input change.

methods.name: gpio_emul_input_set_masked_int
methods.description: Sets input values for pins with validation.

methods.name: gpio_emul_input_set_masked
methods.description: Sets input values for pins with callback invocation.

methods.name: gpio_emul_output_get_masked
methods.description: Retrieves output values for specified pins.

methods.name: gpio_emul_flags_get
methods.description: Gets configuration flags for a specific pin.

methods.name: gpio_emul_pin_configure
methods.description: Configures a GPIO pin with specified flags.

methods.name: gpio_emul_pin_get_config
methods.description: Retrieves configuration flags for a pin.

methods.name: gpio_emul_port_get_raw
methods.description: Gets raw input values for the port.

methods.name: gpio_emul_port_set_masked_raw
methods.description: Sets raw output values for the port.

methods.name: gpio_emul_port_set_bits_raw
methods.description: Sets bits high for output pins.

methods.name: gpio_emul_port_clear_bits_raw
methods.description: Clears bits low for output pins.

methods.name: gpio_emul_port_toggle_bits
methods.description: Toggles specified output pins.

methods.name: gpio_emul_level_trigger_supported
methods.description: Checks if level trigger is supported.

methods.name: gpio_emul_edge_trigger_supported
methods.description: Checks if edge trigger is supported.

methods.name: gpio_emul_pin_interrupt_configure
methods.description: Configures interrupt mode and trigger for a pin.

methods.name: gpio_emul_manage_callback
methods.description: Manages callback registration.

methods.name: gpio_emul_get_pending_int
methods.description: Returns pending interrupt bits.

methods.name: gpio_emul_port_get_direction
methods.description: Gets direction (input/output) of pins.
